draft_by: agent 2026-11-20 from the owner's picks and the board's reasons; owner to confirm or rewrite the checks

picks.name: VHS menu
picks.replaces: iOS green switches in rounded grouped cards
picks.take: ON / OFF as words in a column, the current row in one colour. The settings page already does this; the popup should too.
must: each toggle's state is shown as a word (on / off), not as a switch, slider or pill control
the state words line up in one column on the right, like the values of a menu
the current (hovered or focused) row is marked by one solid colour band across the whole row
the toggles read as a plain list of text rows, not rows inside a rounded card
must_not: a switch or pill-shaped control on any toggle row
open: upper case like the VHS menu or lower case like the settings page
one word (on) or both words with the current one marked ([on] / off) like the settings page

picks.name: B/W pill controls
picks.replaces: iOS segmented control (grey track, white raised thumb)
picks.take: refuse / accept / leave as a two-tone segmented pill, chosen side filled in ink. No system blue, no iOS green.
must: refuse / accept / leave is one outlined pill with the chosen side filled: a soft grey fill at rest, full ink with reversed text on hover or focus
the unchosen sides are plain text on the background
must_not: a grey track with a white raised thumb

picks.name: Struck-through done items
picks.take: 'Handled' shown by taking away: what was answered is struck through.
must: when a banner was handled, the main status line names the handled thing struck through, at full text size
the handled row is set apart as a filled row (a colour field), the way done items are in the reference
must_not: the strike only on a small grey prefix while the line is carried by an unstruck word
open: fill colour of the handled row

picks.name: iA Writer Focus Mode
picks.replaces: every row at the same weight; green, amber, red dots and filled pills all at full strength
must: one thing is at full contrast (this page's status); the rest of the popup is visibly quieter
must_not: several accents competing at full strength (coloured dots, filled pills, ink buttons)

picks.name: Martian Mono
picks.take: Bundle one open-licence mono with italic and caps so every OS renders the same.
must: text is set in Martian Mono
Martian Mono at its natural width; the layout makes room for it
must_not: the typeface condensed (font-stretch below 100%) to fit today's rows

picks.name: Atlas Typewriter
picks.take: the quality bar, not the font

picks.name: Dot + name + count rows
picks.take: Settings stats (banners answered, Shorts hidden) as rows of coloured dot, label and number.
must: each stat is one row: coloured dot, label, number right-aligned

picks.name: doodad.dev support panel
picks.replaces: 'declutter is free. if it saves you clicks, leave a tip.'
picks.take: Inside the tool's own panel, mono, one warm accent, one thank-you line. Never pitch the tip.
must: the tip sits inside the tool's own panel, mono, with one warm accent
must_not: any line that argues for tipping ("if it saves you clicks")
prompts or nagging about the tip

picks.name: Inaccessible Twitter
picks.take: The product shot is a known page minus something (Shorts shelf, banner).
must: the hero shows a recognisable page with the cluttered part removed

picks.name: Charlesworth erased newspaper
picks.take: The page with the noise removed is the hero image.
must: the layout of the page stays; only the clutter is gone

picks.name: Blank billboard
picks.take: The space an ad used to fill.
must: the empty space where the clutter was is visible and left empty

picks.name: Bloomberg pay box
picks.take: The chip never borrows a banner's colour, size or buttons.

picks.name: Stretching blob
picks.take: Morph from 'answering…' to ✓ instead of swapping text.
must: the chip changes shape continuously from the working state to the done state
must_not: the chip's size, colour or buttons resemble a cookie or pay banner

picks.name: Cut-out letters
picks.take: A mono 'declutter' that loses parts but still reads; low volume.
must: letters of 'declutter' have parts missing and the word still reads

picks.name: Black type on rose
picks.replaces: rose only in the small d
picks.take: Rose as a warm field, not a gradient.
must: rose appears as a flat field behind black type

picks.name: Bust with the top cut away
picks.take: An object icon whose subject is a missing part.
must: the icon is an object with a visible part missing

decisions.chose: soft fill at rest, ink on hover
over: outline at rest, fill on hover
decisions.why: B/W pill vs iA Focus Mode: the status stays the one loud thing
